title: Annotated Gemini orbital photo #24: Abilene, San Angelo and Edwards Plateau, Texas
description: Black-and-white orbital terrain photograph on a white mount card, marked "#24" with a north arrow at top. Handwritten labels include "Abilene" at upper left, "San Angelo" and "Edwards Plateau" near the bottom, plus several river and town names. Haze or cloud obscures the right edge of the frame.
